Cada nodo tiene una identidad propia (cl: Every node has its own identity (an Ed25519 key) that costs work to create: a SHA-256d proof of work, the same one used for mining, so a fingerprint cannot be forged for free. When connecting, both nodes sign the handshake and all traffic is encrypted (ChaCha20-Poly1305) with ephemeral session keys. Check the fingerprint with the other person over another channel, as you would with an SSH key.
A diferencia de otras cadenas, tu nodo p: Unlike other chains, your node asks every peer for ALL of its branches (tip announcement → branch request → blocks), not just the main chain. No valid block is lost: losing branches are kept and shared too, exactly as the theory of the Universe of Branched Blocks states.
Todos los pares se autentican con su ide: Every peer authenticates with its identity and speaks encrypted. A node running the old version (v0.6.x) cannot connect until it updates.
Protocolo RAMI-P2P v2: identidad Ed25519: RAMI-P2P v2 protocol: Ed25519 identity with proof of work, X25519 agreement, HKDF-SHA256, ChaCha20-Poly1305.

It also reviews the permissions of your keys, the dashboard token and the executable's hash against the one published in the release. It takes a few seconds.
